title: Resilient chat polling under a slow service

tasks.title: Parallel chat snapshot fan-out
tasks.notes: TestChatSnapshotFanOutOverlaps: four 300ms-delayed upstream reads complete in 0.32s (<600ms pin; sequential would be ~1.2s) — overlap proven. All 8 existing TestChatSnapshot* tests pass unchanged; go vet clean.

tasks.title: Degrade gracefully when auxiliary chat reads fail
tasks.notes: TestChatSnapshotDegradesWhenAuxReadFails pins all three aux failures (active/permission/form → 200 with transcript + data-degraded marker); TestChatSnapshotStillFailsWhenTranscriptReadFails pins transcript failure keeping the upstream error shape. Full go test ./... green — no existing error-shape pin regressed.

tasks.title: Bound poll-path upstream latency
tasks.notes: TestChatSnapshotBoundedWhenServiceStalls: stalled service (2s handlers) + 150ms test budget returns the error shape in 0.18s, far under the 30s client cap; healthy-path tests unaffected; go vet + full internal/server suite green.

tasks.title: Collapse redundant upstream reads
tasks.notes: TestChatSnapshotConcurrentPollsShareOneFetch: 5 concurrent polls → exactly 1 transcript + 1 active upstream fetch (atomic counters); TestChatActiveCacheServesWithinTTL: sequential polls → 1 active fetch (cached) but 2 transcript fetches (only concurrent polls collapse); TestChatActiveCacheDoesNotMemoizeFailure: failed fetch retried next poll, degraded marker clears. go vet + suite green.

tasks.title: Quiet boot-time opencode.json skills patch
tasks.notes: TestEnsureSkillsCatalog pins: live old entry → file byte-identical (skip), dead old entry → healed, garbage old entry → healed, plus existing create/idempotent/JSONC-refusal pins. Live boot after rebuild: zero skills-catalog writes (URL unchanged → no service re-init fired). Full go vet + go test ./... green.

tasks.title: Capability-detect the session wait route
tasks.notes: 5 unit tests pin route selection (experimental-only, both→plain, plain-only, openapi-failure→plain fallback, cached-once) + go vet/test clean. Live: after rebuild+restart, docs jobs no longer die instantly on wait 404 — both chunks enqueued at 22:37:45 and their gardener sessions run with blocking waits; queue drain to be confirmed end-to-end.

tasks.title: Tolerate CLI rename in service discovery
tasks.notes: 5 unit tests pin CLI fallback order, stopped-output skip, short-circuit, all-fail error, and registration-file fallback + go vet/test clean. Live: server restarted with hostile PATH (opencode2→stopped, npm opencode lacking the subcommand) boots with zero integration-disabled warnings via ~/.local/state/opencode/service.json url fallback; docs refresh accepted jobs.

tasks.title: Keep the transcript visible when reads fail under load
tasks.notes: TestChatSnapshotServesLastGoodWhenTranscriptReadFails: after a good poll, breaking the transcript read yields 200 with the old transcript body + data-degraded=true; recovery clears the marker. TestChatSnapshotLastGoodExpires: expired memo fails honestly (502 shape). Budget retuned 8s→15s; transcript failures now logged server-side (previously silent). Full go vet + go test ./... green; deployed and live-verified (snapshot 200/16ms, clean).
